_about: Viral format library: the STRUCTURE of a video (what happens, in which order, why people watch to the end and share). Visual style is chosen per scene in the job file. Word limits are per spoken sentence. Sources: 2026 short-form guides (hook in the first 1-2 s, curiosity gap, contrarian open, one CTA, comment-keyword CTA, repeatable series) — treat their numbers as directional. UPDATE 2026-11-12 (measured on @sudegy.clients + TikTok official guidance, docs/tiktok-algorithm-2026-11-12.md): hook max 6 words, pain or result in its first words, spoken from frame 0; scene 0 must be a moving picture (stage, phone or media), never a title text slide.

dental-empty-chair.why: Targeting dental clinic owners: the financial pain of empty treatment chairs, solved by Sudegy 3D interactive tooth triage and instant WhatsApp booking.

roles.purpose: Empty chair pain: why clinic chairs stay empty and patients drop off.
Why patients avoid booking: agony of phone calls and vague WhatsApp descriptions.
Sudegy interactive 3D dental model: patient pinpoints exact tooth in seconds.
Chair fills up: clinic receives full clinical summary and confirmed booking.
Comment keyword 'عيادة' to get the live interactive demo.

dental-empty-chair.brain: Empathetic, punchy, high-conversion Arabic for clinic owners. Focus on empty chair loss, 3D model prototype, and instant WhatsApp booking.

client-reviews.why: Social proof with genuine WhatsApp feedback and live system recordings builds maximum trust and high conversion.

roles.purpose: Opening promise introducing real client experiences. No brand name.
Dr. Mazin clinical intake system and his genuine review.
Andoria solar calculator and their genuine review.
KF Beauty cosmetics store and their genuine review.
One call to action to comment and get a tailored system.

client-reviews.brain: Narrate with authority, energy, and warmth. Focus on how custom systems solve operational chaos and create client praise.

pov-skit.why: Relatable everyday situation in the first second; viewers tag friends who live the same pain; comedy is the strongest organic format in Sudan's TikTok.

roles.purpose: Name the relatable moment as it happens (لما ... / تخيل ...). No brand name.
The situation gets worse in a funny, believable way.
The real cause, said simply.
How the product removes the cause (one concrete action in the app).
One ask: comment a keyword, or try the app. Echo a word from the hook so the video loops.

pov-skit.brain: Write it like a short comedy skit narrated in one voice. Concrete, visual, everyday. No lecture, no statistics.

myth-fact.why: A contrarian question opens a curiosity gap; people comment their guess before the reveal.

roles.purpose: State a common belief as a question: «... خرافة ولا حقيقة؟»
The verdict in one short sentence (خرافة / حقيقة جزئياً).
The simple, true reason. No numbers unless supplied as facts.
How the product helps you act on the truth.
Ask for the next myth in the comments (series hook).

myth-fact.brain: The belief must be one real people repeat. The verdict must be defensible from the supplied facts only.

five-sec-quiz.why: Viewers answer in the comments; the answer arrives only at the end, so they watch to the end and often rewatch.

roles.purpose: A quick question with 2-3 options the viewer can answer in 5 seconds.
Invite them to write their answer before the reveal.
The answer and why, simply.
How the app helps you know your own answer.

five-sec-quiz.brain: Options must be short words that fit on a button. The answer must come from the supplied facts.

three-mistakes.why: A numbered promise sets clear progress; viewers stay for number three and save the video.

roles.purpose: «٣ أخطاء ... (topic)» framed as something the viewer may be doing now.
Mistake one, concrete.
Mistake two, concrete.
Mistake three, the most surprising.
One way to avoid all three with the product.
Save the video / comment a keyword.

three-mistakes.brain: Mistakes must be true and specific to the supplied facts. Number words in Arabic letters, not digits.

pain-demo.why: Pain first earns attention; a real app demo earns trust; best for explainers and lead generation.

roles.purpose: The pain as a sharp question.
Why it happens.
What it costs the viewer (time, money, comfort) without numbers.
The product, in one line.
First real step in the app.
Second real step.
Third real step.
What the viewer gets.
One ask.

pain-demo.brain: Every step must match a real screen in the recording.

reply-comment.why: Answering a real-sounding question builds community and invites more questions (a content engine).

roles.purpose: Read the viewer question as it appears in the comment bubble.
The direct answer first.
Show it in the app.
Ask for the next question.

reply-comment.brain: The question must be one customers really ask; never invent a username or attribute it to a real person.

satisfying-reveal.why: Visually satisfying motion (liquid, 3D, microscope) is watched twice and loops; best for brand awareness.

roles.purpose: One elegant line that names the brand promise.

series-episode.why: A recurring character and title card turns viewers into followers who wait for the next episode.

roles.purpose: «الحلقة ...: (situation)» with the recurring character.
The episode's problem.
The funny or surprising turn.
The product moment.
Tease the next episode; ask to follow.

series-episode.brain: Keep the same character name and personality across episodes.
